title: [Feature][GLM-5.3-Flash] Enable static kernel compilation for GLM-5.3-Flash
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Three fixes that make static kernel compilation work for GLM-5.3-Flash, all behind `enable_static_kernel`:

- **Decode shape range.** `_compute_decode_cudagraph_batch_sizes` used the raw `cudagraph_capture_sizes`, but the V2 uniform-decode routine rounds token counts up to a multiple of `uniform_decode_query_len` — with MTP5 a configured 56 is captured at 60, which was never compiled. The range now includes the rounded sizes (capped at `max_cudagraph_capture_size`), only when `use_v2_model_runner` and `cudagraph_mode.separate_routine()` hold.
- **`PoolKeyIndexer` blacklist.** It marks three metadata inputs value-dependent while its tiling never reads them. Added to the incompatible-op list so it keeps its dynamic binary.

Plus the four `kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention_vllm` arch35 headers: the installed AscendC package flattens each dependency's `op_kernel` directory, so each `__has_include` chain gets the flattened path as a first branch, with the existing paths unchanged as fallbacks.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No new options or APIs. With `enable_static_kernel` on, more decode sizes are statically compiled and the cache key changes, so the first run recompiles.

### How was this patch tested?

No automated tests yet. NPU validation succeeded for MTP decode replay, installed-package online compilation, and the `PoolKeyIndexer` fallback.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
